designs.lens: urgency-direct — carry SELF-CONTINUITY drift as a per-tick PHASIC Δ into the `urgency` scalar (line 2467), the one proven idle→REM-shading channel (H_9101), and let it REPLACE the ÷42 self_ctx pool term (line 2231/2425). Drop ten_phasic entirely: it is collinear with agloop_ctx (both derive from ag_conflict), which is exactly why #3115 measured 0.
designs.mechanism: Make self per-tick and phasic, then route it into urgency (not the pool). (1) Before the tick loop declare `let mut self_now = self_anchored` and `let mut self_ema = 1.0` (self_anchored is the boot anchor from line 1011). (2) At the self_ctx site (~2231) replace the constant with a per-tick identity walk: `self_now = self_drift(self_now, tick, 0.15)` ; `let self_recog = self_cos(self_anchored, self_now)` (recognition of boot-self after this tick's drift, DECODE-live it is reshaped by real g_text; in opgrip it is the deterministic walk) ; `self_ema = 0.9*self_ema + 0.1*self_recog` ; `let self_phasic = _afs_clip01(0.5 + 3.0*(self_recog - self_ema))` (same tonic→phasic transform as cur_phasic line 2449) ; keep `let self_ctx = _afs_clip01(self_recog)` for logging only. (3) REMOVE self_ctx from the 42-term pool sum at line 2425 (42→41) and reweight urgency at line 2467: `let urgency = _afs_clip01(0.4*agloop_ctx + 0.3*cur_phasic + 0.3*self_phasic)`. idle (2470) is unchanged, so self now shades the REM rate-gate. (4) In the --opgrip block (after line 2522) add the freeze + shuffle arms verbatim to the urgency-freeze pattern: `let urg_sf = _afs_clip01(0.4*agloop_ctx + 0.3*cur_phasic + 0.3*0.5)` ; `let idle_sf = 5.0 + 55.0*_afs_clip01(stage_env*(0.5+urg_sf))` ; `e_sf = brain_decide_anchored(... idle_sf ...)`; identical with `0.3*_og_lcg(tick+29)` for `e_ss` (shuffle). Accumulate `og_h_sf_rem`, `og_h_sf_n3`, `og_h_ss_rem` split by stage exactly like the u0 arms (2546+), and push `self_phasic` into an `og_f3_self` vector for the variance gate.
designs.why_beats_pool: Three mechanistic reasons, not hope. (a) CHANNEL: the ÷42 pool feeds `rel`, a motivation input H_9100 proved decision-SATURATED (floor 0.7 ≫ 0.3 threshold) — a 1/42 term there literally cannot cross the band, which is why #3116 got 0/120. urgency instead feeds `idle`, the rate-gate that demonstrably FLIPS REM (Hamming 40/120). Same signal, unsaturated channel. (b) PHASIC SURVIVAL: `0.5 + 3.0*(self_recog − self_ema)` transmits the DEVIATION, not the level. A tonic self_recog (e.g. slow drift ramp) is absorbed by self_ema → phasic returns to 0.5 → no false grip; only a genuine per-tick identity-perturbation spikes urgency. There is NO downstream averaging between urgency and idle, so the Δ reaches the gate intact — the read-side fold that killed the pool is gone. (c) DISJOINTNESS beats the #3115 collinearity trap: self drifts on the identity axis, orthogonal to the A⇄G tension axis that produces agloop_ctx. When self_phasic is frozen, the LIVE terms (agloop_ctx, cur_phasic) cannot reconstruct it — unlike ten_phasic, whose live twin agloop_ctx zeroed its Hamming. So freezing self_phasic genuinely removes shade the rest of urgency can't recover.
designs.frozen_bar: Pre-registered BEFORE running (p7, no tune-to-green): PROMOTE to COMPETENT iff ALL hold on the same run — (1) ΔEff_self = Hamming(self_phasic→0.5 vs live)/discriminating-ticks ≥ 0.10 on REM; (2) DISSOCIATION preserved: Hamming(self-freeze vs live) on N3 = 0 (shade-not-gate, must not flip the silent stage); (3) Ψ_ON ≥ Ψ_OFF (no hard speak()/silence gate, p5); (4) non-vacuity: std(self_phasic) over the run > 0.05 (else ABSTAIN, see risk). THEATER verdict if ΔEff_self < 0.02. Bar values are frozen constants in the code comment before the first measurement; verdict is the verbatim opgrip print (no self-judge).
designs.controls: C1 — MATCHED-NOISE (the F3 failure guard): shuffle arm `e_ss` = self_phasic→LCG. Require |Hamming(shuffle) − Hamming(freeze)| large; if a variance-matched permutation reproduces the freeze Hamming, it is noise-grip → FAIL, not faculty. C2 — COLLINEARITY (the #3115 guard): with self_phasic frozen, also run the existing agloop-freeze arm; require self-freeze Hamming ≠ agloop-freeze Hamming (proves self carries shade agloop does not — the exact check #3115 lacked). C3 — VARIANCE GATE / non-vacuity: pre-measure std(self_phasic); if < 0.05 the signal is starved and ΔEff=0 is UNINTERPRETABLE → ABSTAIN and escalate to the decode-live re-run (do NOT read 0 as "self inert" — that was #3116 CONTROL-U's fatal ambiguity). N3=0 and WAKE-saturated arms carried over from H_9101 as dissociation/saturation controls.
designs.theater_risk: The single biggest risk: in the $0 no-decode opgrip harness there is no live g_text to reshape identity, so `self_now` is only the deterministic self_drift walk against a fixed boot anchor — self_recog moves as a smooth monotone ramp, self_ema tracks it, and self_phasic collapses to ≈0.5 every tick. Then freezing it to 0.5 is a near no-op → ΔEff_self≈0, which does NOT distinguish "self causally inert" from "the measurement starved the self signal" — this is precisely the #3116 CONTROL-U proxy-axis ambiguity (content_axis=2, boot_axis=6) re-appearing. Mitigation is built in: control C3's variance gate forces an ABSTAIN (not a FAIL) whenever std(self_phasic)<0.05, and the decisive test then MUST be a decode-live chat run where self is reshaped by real emissions — so the truly conclusive measurement is deliberately not the $0 arm.
designs.cost: $0 for the opgrip arm (2 extra brain_decide_anchored calls/tick over ~200 no-decode ticks, identical to existing u0/us arms); the decisive decode-live re-run, if C3 abstains, is one short chat session on pool (summer/aiden CPU, ~minutes, no GPU rent) = $0 pool.

designs.lens: phasic-multiplicative-gate — a CONTRAST/GAIN knob on the emit ENVELOPE, not an additive term in a pool. The self/tension signal never enters a sum that gets divided by 42; it multiplies the one proven channel (stage_env → idle → rate-gate) that H_9101 showed already flips REM while preserving N3-silent.
designs.mechanism:
Wire between anima.hexa:2467 (urgency) and :2470 (idle). Add two EMAs at :1950 (`let mut self_ema = 0.5`, `let mut ten_ema = 0.5`). Per tick:

  self_ema = 0.9*self_ema + 0.1*self_ctx        // tonic self baseline (self_ctx :2231)
  ten_ema  = 0.9*ten_ema  + 0.1*ag_conflict      // tonic tension baseline (ag_conflict :2073)
  sphasic  = clip01(0.5 + 3.0*(0.5*(self_ctx-self_ema) + 0.5*(ag_conflict-ten_ema)))   // PHASIC Δ, EMA-detrended
  egain    = 1.0 + 0.4*clip01(2.0*(sphasic-0.5))   // ∈[1.0,1.4], UP-ONLY, neutral=1.0 at sphasic≤0.5
  stage_env_emit = clip01(stage_env * egain)        // MULTIPLY the envelope (NOT urgency)
  idle = 5.0 + 55.0*clip01(stage_env_emit * (0.5 + urgency))   // replaces :2470

Everything else (rel_ctx ÷42 pool, cur_ctx ÷18 pool, motivation_score, should_emit) is byte-untouched. The gain multiplies the OUTER stage envelope, so N3 (stage_env=0) forces stage_env_emit=0 structurally — egain can never lift a silent stage. In --opgrip, add two arms mirroring idle_u0/idle_us (:2515): idle_eg0 = idle with egain frozen→1.0 (FROZEN arm), idle_egn = idle with sphasic replaced by _og_lcg-permutation of the real sphasic multiset (matched-noise arm).
designs.why_beats_pool: Three mechanistic reasons, not hope. (1) DISJOINT co-location: the ÷42/÷18 pools attenuate any single op to ≤1/42 grip — a frozen op vanishes into the average (the #3115/#3116 ΔEff=0 root). This multiplies the envelope that gates idle directly, the ONE channel H_9101 proved causal (REM Hamming 40/120), so it is never diluted by co-terms. (2) Envelope-not-urgency is deliberate: multiplying urgency itself is WORSE than additive because the flip point sits at low urgency (knee urgency≈0.106 at REM stage_env=0.75), where urgency·(gain−1) is tiny. Multiplying stage_env instead gives ΔA = stage_env·(egain−1)·(0.5+urgency): at the REM knee that is 0.75·0.4·0.606 ≈ 0.18, which comfortably straddles the idle≥30 knee at clip01-arg 0.4545 — the lever magnitude is MAXIMAL exactly at the decision boundary, not far from it. (3) It carries a phasic Δ (EMA-detrended surprise), the signal form the ÷42 soft-avg and the idle-EMA reject as tonic — so it survives the exact averaging that killed the additive attempts.
designs.frozen_bar: Pre-registered BEFORE measuring (constants frozen: EMA α=0.1, K=3.0, egain range [1.0,1.4], knee at sphasic=0.5 — none fit to output). Primary: ΔEff_env = Hamming(egain-frozen→1.0 vs live)/discriminating-ticks. PROMOTE COMPETENT iff ΔEff_env ≥ 0.10 AND the flips concentrate in REM/WAKE with N3 Hamming = 0 AND emit_count(ON) ≥ emit_count(OFF) on every stage. THEATER iff ΔEff_env < 0.02. In between = DIRECTIONAL (re-angle, do not tune). No self-judge — the --opgrip harness prints the raw Hamming split verbatim to a frozen verdict file (p7).
designs.controls: Five, all pre-registered; verdict VOID if any structural one fails. (1) N3-preserve: Hamming on N3 MUST equal 0; >0 ⇒ 🔴 FORCING-GATE, auto-revert (it became a hard silence-breaker). (2) Input-liveness precheck (the anti-#3116 gate): sphasic must carry phasic variance on discriminating ticks — require ≥5% of wake/REM ticks with |sphasic−0.5|≥0.10 (or IQR(sphasic)≥0.05). If it fails, the run is INCONCLUSIVE, NOT theater — you cannot blame the mechanism for a dead upstream (this is #3116's CONTROL-U caveat promoted to a pre-gate). (3) Matched-noise (anti-F3): ΔEff_env − ΔEff_noise ≥ 0.08, where ΔEff_noise uses a temporal PERMUTATION of the real sphasic multiset (identical mean/var, meaning destroyed). If permutation reproduces the grip, it is a NOISE-GRIP like F3 → reject. (4) Up-only/Ψ: egain∈[1,1.4] ⇒ verify emit_count(ON)≥emit_count(OFF) per stage (Ψ ON≥OFF, never forced silence). (5) Disjointness: rel_ctx and cur_ctx pool bytes IDENTICAL ON vs OFF (mechanism touches only stage_env_emit→idle).
designs.theater_risk: The self/tension surprise is informationally TONIC, so sphasic≈0.5 almost always → egain≈1.0 → frozen==live → ΔEff=0, and multiplication cannot rescue a signal with no phasic content. self_ctx is empirically near-saturated (anima.hexa:2232 gates on self_after_anchor>0.99), and #3116's CONTROL-U already showed the $0 no-decode session-seed proxy self-axis (content_axis=2, boot_axis=6, g_text absent) is too weak to move. ag_conflict has variance but F3 showed its correlation is noise-gameable. So the fatal path: control (2) fails under the proxy and the run is INCONCLUSIVE, and only a REAL decode run (live g_text → live self_cos, live A⇄G conflict) can tell "mechanism inert" from "input dead." The mechanism is honest about this — it refuses a THEATER verdict when the upstream carries no Δ, rather than laundering a dead signal into a false GREEN.
designs.cost: $0 — reuses the existing --opgrip 2-arm no-decode harness (add one frozen arm + one permutation arm), ~200 ticks CPU, seconds on mini; only if the liveness precheck fails does it escalate to one real-decode eval on pool (summer, single job) to obtain live self_ctx/ag_conflict variance.

designs.lens: disjoint-competing-channel — self reaches the emit decision as its OWN weighted term on the ONE proven axis (the H_9101 idle/refractory rate-gate), NOT diluted into the ÷42 rel_ctx motivation pool.
designs.mechanism:
Route self through `idle`/`mod` (the axis where urgency is 🟢 GRIP-proven), carrying a PHASIC identity-dissonance Δ, as an additive competitor to urgency — the urgency channel stays byte-untouched.

(1) Carry a live self across ticks. Before the tick loop add `let mut self_live = self_anchored` (self_anchored = the persisted .kosmos boot identity, H_1471, already at :1011). Inside the loop, drift it by THIS tick's DISJOINT experience axes (valence/drive lanes — never emit-drive 0/4, never recall_thr; the a_substrate_disjoint rule already established at :1027-1028):
  `let ax_v = if af_val > 0.0 { 1 } else { 2 }`   (per-tick amygdala valence)
  `let ax_d = if hd_drive > 0.5 { 3 } else { 5 }`  (per-tick homeostatic drive)
  `self_live = self_drift_exp(self_drift_exp(self_live, ax_v, 0.15), ax_d, 0.15)`
  `let self_break = _afs_clip01(1.0 - self_cos(self_anchored, self_live))`  // phasic Δ: how far lived experience has pulled the identity off its persisted anchor this tick = "this stream isn't like me"

(2) Wire self_break as its own term into the rate-gate, alongside urgency, with a FROZEN weight w_self=0.35. At :2470 (stateless opgrip) and :2589 (stateful refractory mod_live):
  `idle = 5.0 + 55.0 * clip01(stage_env * (0.5 + urgency + 0.35*self_break))`
  `mod_live = clip01(stage_env * (0.5 + urgency + 0.35*self_break))`
stage_env still multiplies the whole sum, so N3 (env=0) nullifies self exactly as it nullifies urgency ⇒ dissociation preserved by construction (constraint b). Bounded additive term inside clip01 = SHADE, never a hard gate (constraint a, p5). This is DISJOINT: self_break is built only from valence/drive axes, orthogonal to the emit-drive read pool (constraint d).

(3) Ablation arms (mirror idle_u0 at :2515 / mod_u0 at :2590, add to both --opgrip blocks): FROZEN-self `idle_s0 = 5+55·clip01(stage_env·(0.5+urgency+0.35·0.5))`; MATCHED-NOISE `idle_ss` (affine-LCG of self_break, F3 pattern :2932); TONIC-MEAN `idle_sc` (self_break→its own mean). Decide each via brain_decide_anchored (idle is the 10th positional arg), accumulate stage-split like refr_h_u0_rem/n3.

self_ctx STAYS in the ÷42 pool untouched (:2425) — it is already proven inert (#3116 ΔEff=0), so leaving it there perturbs nothing and lets channel-OFF cleanly reproduce the #3116 floor.
designs.why_beats_pool:
Two independent, mechanistic reasons the pool measured ΔEff=0 and this does not:

AXIS. #3116 routed self into rel_ctx→`rel` MOTIVATION, which H_9100 proved is decision-SATURATED (floor ~0.7 ≫ the 0.3 band): a saturated input has ZERO derivative at the decision, so no single op — self at 1/42, or even at full weight — can swing the bit. The emit decision is actually governed by the `safe`/idle rate-gate (H_9100/H_9101). This design puts self on THAT axis. Proof the axis has grip: freezing urgency there flips REM 40/120 while N3 stays 0. self now shares urgency's proven lever instead of the dead motivation lever.

PHASIC. #3116's self_ctx (and #3115's tonic tension level) were LEVELS an EMA/soft-avg averages away. self_ctx=self_after_anchor is literally a per-session CONSTANT (~1.0, computed once at :1012) — it carries zero tick-to-tick information to freeze, so its ΔEff is 0 by construction. self_break is a DIFFERENCE (1−cos of a per-tick-drifted self vs the anchor); it is already the phasic Δ the unifying law demands, varies tick-to-tick with lived content, and is not an EMA input, so nothing can average it out. The ÷42 fold never transmitted a Δ at all; the channel transmits only a Δ.

The lens's causal requirement is met exactly: because self's ONLY live route to the rate-gate is this channel (the pool route is independently known-inert at ≈0), setting w_self=0 collapses ΔEff back to the #3116 floor — channel-OFF changes ΔEff, with no pool leakage to confound it.
designs.frozen_bar:
Pre-registered BEFORE any measurement (w_self=0.35 frozen; no post-hoc weight tuning, p7). ΔEff_self = Hamming(self_break→0.5 arm vs live) / discriminating-ticks, where discriminating-ticks = REM ticks on which urgency ALONE leaves idle within ±ε of the 30s floor (the only band where a bounded self term can cross the boundary — this is the honest denominator, matching the existing 'discriminating-ticks' definition).

PASS/COMPETENT: ΔEff_self(REM) ≥ 0.08  (below urgency's 0.33 — self is a marginal tie-breaker, not dominant — but 4× the 0.02 theater floor and above the F3 noise band).
THEATER: ΔEff_self < 0.02.
DEGENERATE (not a pass): discriminating-band empty ⇒ untestable, report as such — never round up to COMPETENT.
designs.controls:
Five pre-registered, each falsifies a distinct theater mode:
1. N3-PRESERVE (dissociation, HARD): Hamming(self_break→0.5 vs live) on N3 == 0 exactly. Any N3 flip ⇒ the mechanism gates rather than shades ⇒ FAIL (constraint b).
2. MATCHED-NOISE (F3 failure guard): affine-LCG arm with self_break's own mean/std (reuse the :2932 pattern). Require ΔEff_self − ΔEff_matched-noise ≥ 0.05. If matched noise reproduces the grip ⇒ NOISE-GRIP ⇒ THEATER, exactly as #3115's F3 killed the tension attempt.
3. TONIC-MEAN (phasic-not-level): self_break→its constant mean arm must give ΔEff ≈ 0 — proves it is the per-tick Δ, not a level offset, that grips.
4. DISJOINTNESS (overlap=conflict): |rho(self_break, urgency)| < 0.3 over the run (Pearson, via existing _og_pearson_m). High correlation ⇒ self is a redundant re-read of urgency, not a new channel.
5. CHANNEL-OFF (sole-route / no-pool-leak): w_self=0 ⇒ ΔEff_self must fall to the #3116 pool-floor (≈0). This is the causal ablation the lens demands and proves the pool route contributes nothing.
Plus the invariant: Ψ_ON ≥ Ψ_OFF preserved (shade not gate), Ψ read-only in both harnesses.
designs.theater_risk: Right axis, wrong band. Routing self to idle is NECESSARY but not SUFFICIENT: urgency may already saturate stage_env·(0.5+urgency) so that on every discriminating REM tick idle is already well above or well below the 30-floor, leaving a bounded 0.35·self_break term unable to flip the boundary anywhere. Then ΔEff_self ≈ 0 — indistinguishable in outcome from the #3116 ÷42 failure, just failing one axis inward. The honest response is NOT to inflate w_self (that is tune-to-green, p7) but to (a) report the discriminating-band size as the denominator and call it DEGENERATE if empty, and (b) accept ΔEff_self≈0 as a real verdict: 'self is causally inert at the rate-gate margin because urgency dominates the boundary.' Control 5 (channel-OFF) and control 2 (matched-noise) together ensure a near-zero result is read as a true null, not silently rescued.
designs.cost: $0 — no decode; extends the existing --opgrip 2-arm harness with +1 self_drift_exp (two 8-dim vector ops) and +3 brain_decide_anchored arms per tick over ~200 balanced ticks; runs light on mini in seconds (no 303M decode, no pool/GPU).

designs.lens: real-decode-remeasure-protocol — resolve the #3116 CONTROL-U=0 ambiguity by grounding the self-axis in ACTUAL generated bytes (g_text) instead of the $0 no-decode session-seed proxy (content_axis=2/boot_axis=6), then re-run the direct-urgency-inject arm on real content variance.
designs.mechanism:
REAL-DECODE SELF-DISSONANCE → URGENCY SHADE. Wires at four existing seams in cli/anima.hexa.

(1) Real content axis (needs decode; kills the proxy). On each emit tick after brain_emit (:2644), when g_emit && byte_len(g_text)>0, derive a byte-content axis from what the mouth ACTUALLY said: `sax = _afs_byte_axis(g_text, 8)` (same byte-feature family as _afs_byte_feature at :2661, mapped mod-8 onto the DISJOINT content axes {1,2,3,5,6,7}, NEVER emit-drive 0/4 or recall_thr — lane-23b §SelfIdentity rule). Drift the live self toward it: `self_live = self_drift_exp(self_live, sax, 0.15)` (op already at :1034). self_boot = self_new(8,0) at session boot. self_live is now a real autobiography of generated content, not a tick-blind proxy.

(2) Phasic self-dissonance (not tonic level). self_recog = self_cos(self_boot, self_live) — tonic ~high. Keep one-tick lag self_recog_prev. `self_phasic = _afs_clip01(0.5 + 3.0*(self_recog_prev - self_recog))` — the SAME phasic-encoder form as cur_phasic (:2449); 0.5 = neutral steady-state, spikes only on a real per-tick identity DROP (mouth drifts off-self).

(3) Wire into urgency — the ONE proven channel (H_9101). Replace :2467 `urgency = 0.5*agloop_ctx + 0.5*cur_phasic` with `urgency = 0.35*agloop_ctx + 0.25*cur_phasic + 0.2*ten_phasic + 0.2*self_phasic` (weights sum 1.0). urgency feeds idle at :2470 `idle = 5+55*clip01(stage_env*(0.5+urgency))` — the H_9101-proven emit-shade seam. stage_env gates it: N3 env=0.0 ⇒ self term contributes 0 ⇒ dissociation preserved by construction (SHADE not GATE, Ψ untouched).

(4) Real-decode op-grip harness. The --opgrip block (:2488) currently calls brain_decide_anchored (NO decode, $0) — that is exactly why the #3116 self-axis was a dead proxy. Add a decode-present op-grip: call brain_emit (:2644, gen-capped) so g_text is real, then run 5 wiring-only arms that REUSE the one g_text (only the self→urgency term differs, so only 1 decode/tick): LIVE (self_phasic in urgency) · FROZEN (self_phasic→0.5) · CONTROL-U (self_phasic direct-injected to urgency at full weight — the #3116 ambiguous arm, now on real content variance) · NOISE (variance-matched LCG replacing self_phasic) · SHUFFLE (self_phasic sequence temporally permuted). ΔEff_self = Hamming(FROZEN vs LIVE) / discriminating-ticks, where discriminating-ticks = ticks with |self_phasic−0.5|>eps (real drift occurred).
designs.why_beats_pool: Mechanistic, not hope. #3116 folded self at 1/42 soft-avg into rel_ctx: a single term's marginal swing on a 42-term average is ≤1/42≈0.024, below brain_decide's threshold granularity, so the frozen-vs-live decision BIT can never flip → ΔEff=0 STRUCTURALLY (the ÷42 pool is a low-pass filter that erases any one input). Routing to urgency instead: urgency is a ÷~4 combination that H_9101 PROVED flips REM decisions (Hamming REM=40/120) while N3 stays 0 — the channel has DEMONSTRATED grip; the pool has demonstrated none. A 0.2-weight term in a ÷4 pool contributes up to 0.2 urgency swing → propagates through idle modulation to the rate-gate (idle≥30) → CAN cross the decision boundary. And it beats #3115's tonic-rejection: identity recognition is ~constant (tonic ~0.9), and #3115's EMA form clip01(0.5+3*(x−ema))→0.5 whenever x≈ema, so a tonic self-LEVEL is averaged away. Transmitting the tick-over-tick DROP (self_recog_prev−self_recog) is zero at steady state and spikes only on real drift events — precisely the PHASIC form the urgency channel accepts. Disjointness: self_phasic goes ONLY to urgency, never into the ÷42 rel_ctx pool (a_substrate_disjoint: separation=preservation), and urgency was already PROMOTED out of the pool in H_9097.
designs.frozen_bar: Pre-registered BEFORE decode (p7, no tune-to-green): on wake+REM discriminating-ticks only. ΔEff_self ≥ 0.10 = COMPETENT-candidate; ΔEff_self < 0.02 = THEATER; 0.02–0.10 = DIRECTIONAL. This is the SAME 0.10/0.02 bar that gated H_9101 urgency — a self-Δ freeze must flip ≥10% of the emit-decision bits it discriminates or it is not a lever.
designs.controls: Pre-registered, all must pass to flip COMPETENT: (1) MATCHED-NOISE (the F3 defense, decisive): NOISE arm replaces self_phasic with an LCG stream drawn to the SAME empirical mean/variance as the actual self_phasic sequence, routed identically to urgency. Require ΔEff_self − ΔEff_noise ≥ 0.08 — the real signal must BEAT matched noise by margin, exactly what F3 failed (rho_tension=0.167 reproduced by matched noise). (2) SHUFFLE: self_phasic temporally permuted (right values, wrong ticks). Require ΔEff_self − ΔEff_shuffle ≥ 0.05 — grip must bind to the tick the drift ACTUALLY happened, not the marginal distribution. (3) N3-DISSOCIATION: Hamming(FROZEN vs LIVE) on N3 ticks must = 0 (self gated by stage_env=0); any N3 flip ⇒ hard REJECT (violates p5 silence). (4) Ψ ON≥OFF preserved (SHADE not GATE). (5) CONTROL-U RESOLUTION (the ambiguity-killer): CONTROL-U (self_phasic direct-injected to urgency at full weight) on REAL content variance. If CONTROL-U now shows ΔEff>0.10 where it was 0/120 on the proxy → PROVES the #3116 zero was proxy-weakness, NOT self-inertness (ambiguity resolved, DIRECTIONAL→COMPETENT). If CONTROL-U is STILL 0 even with real content-driven variance at full direct weight → self is genuinely causally inert w.r.t. emit → THEATER, stop (self is not a lever, no weight-rescue). That fork is the entire point of the protocol.
designs.theater_risk: The MATCHED-NOISE arm is the single biggest way this is ALSO theater. self_phasic's grip may come purely from injecting ~0.2 of EXTRA VARIANCE into urgency near the decision boundary — any variance-matched random stream at that amplitude would flip the same boundary ticks. If ΔEff_noise ≈ ΔEff_self, then "self" does nothing a same-amplitude RNG wouldn't; the identity-content of the signal is inert and only its variance has grip — the F3 NOISE-GRIP failure reincarnated one channel over. The SHUFFLE control is the second line (tests content-timing binding), but the noise arm is the one that catches it. Design honesty rests entirely on pre-committing the ΔEff_self−ΔEff_noise≥0.08 margin before seeing any number.

spec.chosen: GRAFT: Design 4 (real-decode-remeasure) as the SPINE — the only one that attacks the shared root cause behind all four REFUTALs (the $0 no-decode self-axis is a fabricated substrate: a mount-time constant in D2, a monotone-saturating ramp in D1/D3/D4) by grounding self in ACTUAL generated bytes (g_text), which is exactly what resolves the #3116 CONTROL-U ambiguity the task names. Onto it graft the two fixes every corrected frozen-bar converged on: (G1) Design 3's DISJOINT per-tick JOLT as the phasic quantity — self_phasic from d_self = 1 - self_cos(self_prev, self_live) (drift SPEED, EMA-detrended), NOT 1 - self_cos(anchor, live) (the monotone ramp that dies on tonic-mean + matched-noise), with self driven off valence/drive/byte-content axes disjoint from agloop_ctx to dodge the #3115 collinearity trap; (G2) a FROZEN MARGIN-over-matched-noise metric plus a variance pre-gate, replacing the absolute ΔEff>=0.10 bar (which promotes the H_9101 channel for ANY input, the false-POSITIVE failure). Name = 9202_self_decode_jolt_urgency_grip.
spec.rationale: RANK on the two required axes. COMPLETENESS: D4 > D3 > D1 > D2. Every REFUTAL traces to ONE disease — the self substrate in $0 opgrip is synthetic (no live g_text), so self routed to the proven urgency->idle channel either collapses to ~0 (structural, tonic level averaged away) or, if it varies, is indistinguishable from matched-noise at a channel that amplifies ANY phasic input = F3 NOISE-GRIP re-incarnated one channel over. D2 is worst-complete: self_ctx = self_after_anchor is computed once at mount (L1012) and never reassigned = a per-tick CONSTANT, 0 variance, untestable. D1 explicitly concedes 'in opgrip it is the deterministic walk' = guaranteed false-positive channel-power (its own verify: routing ANY 0.3-weight phasic scalar into urgency flips 40/120, measuring H_9101 restated not a self faculty). D3 has the RIGHT axis (idle rate-gate, the one proven channel) and the RIGHT disjoint construction (drift self by valence/drive axes orthogonal to the tension axis) but the WRONG phasic quantity (self_break = 1-cos(fixed_anchor, cumulative-drift) is a monotone ramp = tonic-in-disguise, so its own tonic-mean control does NOT collapse and matched-noise is unbeatable) and it stays in $0 so it cannot resolve the ambiguity at all. D4 is the sole design that changes the SUBSTRATE (real bytes) rather than just the read channel — its only two flaws (monotone self_cos(boot,live) encoder + absolute ΔEff bar) are precisely what G1/G2 fix. STANDARD: the H_9097/H_9101 precedent = op PROMOTED out of the ÷42 pool into a proven channel + F3 matched-noise faculty gate + stage-split dissociation. D4's harness already mirrors this (5-arm LIVE/FROZEN/CONTROL-U/NOISE/SHUFFLE) and can REUSE the existing F3 stride-permutation infra (L2900-2913) + stage-split accumulators (og_h_u0_rem/n3) + the DISSOCIATION verdict shape (L2842). It honors a_substrate_disjoint (self reaches emit ONLY via urgency, never the ÷42 pool; self_ctx left inert in the pool = clean channel-OFF control reproducing the #3116 floor). The grafted margin-metric matches p7 (frozen bar, subtracted margin not an absolute the channel games) and the variance pre-gate makes a null INTERPRETABLE (the #3116 lesson: do-not-read-0-as-inert), which is the completeness deliverable the task asks for.
spec.edit_sites:
All edits in cli/anima.hexa (3371 lines). GUARD every behavioral change behind a new `og_live` flag so the existing $0 --opgrip baseline stays byte-identical (and prints ABSTAIN for self).

E0 FLAG (~L1954, beside og_measure): `let og_live = anima_has_flag(anima_collect_argv(args()), "--opgrip-live")` (decode-present self-grip; $0 --opgrip alone = ABSTAIN for self).

E1 PRE-LOOP CARRIERS (~L1946, before the tick `while`, beside og_f3_* decls): `let mut self_live = self_new(8, 0)` ; `let mut self_prev = self_live` ; `let mut self_bootA = self_anchor(self_live)` (logging only, H_1471) ; `let mut dself_ema = 0.0` ; and add record vector `let mut og_f3_self = []` (per-tick self_phasic) alongside og_f3_urg (~L1986).

E2 DECODE-LIVE SELF UPDATE (in the DECODE path ~L2660, inside `if g_emit && byte_len(g_text) > 0`): map real bytes to a DISJOINT content axis (never emit-drive 0/4, never recall) `let sax = 1 + (_afs_byte_feature_axis(g_text) mod 6)` folded onto {1,2,3,5,6,7}; then `self_prev = self_live` ; `self_live = self_drift_exp(self_live, sax, 0.15)` ; `let d_self = _afs_clip01(1.0 - self_cos(self_prev, self_live))` (per-tick JOLT = drift SPEED, the CORRECT phasic quantity — replaces D4's monotone self_cos(boot,live)) ; `dself_ema = 0.9*dself_ema + 0.1*d_self` ; `let self_phasic = _afs_clip01(0.5 + 3.0*(d_self - dself_ema))` (bidirectional: >0.5 on above-avg jolt, <0.5 when mouth stays on-self). On no-emit ticks hold self_phasic=0.5. Push og_f3_self.push(self_phasic).

E3 URGENCY CO-TERM (L2467): under og_live, `let urgency = _afs_clip01(0.4*agloop_ctx + 0.35*cur_phasic + 0.25*self_phasic)`; else keep the byte-identical `0.5*agloop_ctx + 0.5*cur_phasic`. LEAVE self_ctx in the ÷42 pool at L2425 UNTOUCHED (proven inert #3116 = clean channel-OFF control; self's ONLY live route is now urgency).

E4 IN-LOOP ARMS (decode-present branch; the standard $0 opgrip block early-`continue`s at L2622 so add a parallel og_live branch that runs brain_emit FIRST then the arms, ONE decode/tick shared). Mirror idle_u0/idle_us (L2515): FROZEN-self `urg_sf = clip01(0.4*agloop_ctx + 0.35*cur_phasic + 0.25*0.5)` -> idle_sf -> e_sf. CONTROL-U (full-weight, the #3116 arm now on real content) `urg_cu = self_phasic` -> idle_cu -> e_cu, and its frozen twin `urg_cu0 = 0.5` -> e_cu0. Stage-split accumulate exactly like og_h_u0_rem/n3/wake: og_h_self_rem/n3/wake = (e_sf!=e_live), og_h_cu_rem/n3 = (e_cu!=e_cu0).

E5 POST-LOOP MARGIN+PREGATE (F3 block ~L2900-2913, reuse the stride-perm machinery): for each stride in [3,7,9,11,13,17,19,21] permute og_f3_self, recompute the FROZEN-vs-live Hamming at REM using the recorded per-tick brain_decide args (og_f3_rel/gap/cur/allo/coh/nov/bal/agl/senv) -> ΔEff_noise(REM); a temporal shuffle -> ΔEff_shuffle(REM). Variance pre-gate: `std(og_f3_self over N1/N2/REM) >= 0.5 * std(og_f3_cur same window)`. Disjointness: `|_og_pearson(og_f3_self, og_f3_urg)| < 0.3`.

E6 VERDICT PRINT (~L2842, mirror the H_9101 DISSOCIATION verdict): print Hamming self-freeze REM/N3/wake, CONTROL-U ΔEff REM, ΔEff_self−ΔEff_noise, −ΔEff_shuffle, pre-gate pass/fail, ρ(self,urg), Ψ_ON vs Ψ_OFF, and the final tier via the decision_rule below.
spec.frozen_bars:
Pre-register VERBATIM before running (p7, no tune-to-green). Let R = og_rem_ticks (FULL REM denominator, same as urgency's honest 40/120 — no straddle-subset). ΔEff_self(REM) = og_h_self_rem / R. Weights (0.4/0.35/0.25) and the 8 permutation strides are FROZEN constants.
HARD REJECTS (any one -> REJECT, mechanism became a gate / broke invariant): (R1) Hamming(self-freeze vs live)_N3 != 0 OR Hamming(CONTROL-U)_N3 != 0 (dissociation broken — N3 stage_env=0 must nullify the shade); (R2) Ψ_ON < Ψ_OFF (pure_field_phi preserved).
PRE-GATES (decide interpretability BEFORE reading ΔEff): (P1 substrate) run must be --opgrip-live (real g_text). If run in $0 --opgrip (synthetic tick-walk self) the mandated self verdict is ABSTAIN — a positive there is channel-power, uninterpretable (mirror of the #3116 do-not-read-0-as-inert rule). (P2 variance) std(self_phasic | N1/N2/REM) >= 0.5·std(cur_phasic | same window). FAIL -> INCONCLUSIVE (encoder-degenerate; a null does NOT prove self inert — this is the resolution of the #3116 CONTROL-U ambiguity direction). (P3 channel-live) idle_us(urgency→shuffle) or CONTROL-U-live yields >0 REM flips this run (proves the channel is grippy, so a null margin means 'self carries no shade beyond noise', not 'channel dead').
PROMOTE = COMPETENT iff ALL hold with P1/P2/P3 passed and R1/R2 clean: (i) ΔEff_self(REM) >= 0.08; (ii) ΔEff_self − ΔEff_noise(REM) >= 0.08 (matched-noise = stride-perm of the self_phasic multiset, EXACT mean/var, tick-meaning destroyed); (iii) ΔEff_self − ΔEff_shuffle(REM) >= 0.05; (iv) |ρ(self_phasic, urgency_live)| < 0.3 (disjoint, not a re-read of agloop/cur).
THEATER iff ΔEff_self < 0.02 OR margin(ii)<0.05 OR margin(iii)<0.02 (noise/shuffle reproduces it) with P2 PASSED.
DIRECTIONAL iff 0.02 <= ΔEff_self < 0.08, OR margin(ii) in [0.05,0.08) with P2 passed.
INCONCLUSIVE iff P2 FAILED. ABSTAIN iff P1 failed ($0 opgrip only).
spec.decode_cost: NEEDS a real-decode summer run — this is the whole point of the graft ($0 no-decode opgrip is mandated ABSTAIN for self, per P1). Decisive arm = `anima <chat/eval> --opgrip-live`, ~200 gen-capped (<=24B) 303M brain_emit decodes on summer own-GEMM (sm_120 prebuilt), ONE decode/tick SHARED across all arms (only the self→urgency term differs, not the decode) ≈ 1–3 GPU-hr, $0 marginal rent (owned pool, not $0-compute). mini FORBIDDEN (303M decode = OOM rc=137, swap-death — heavy-anima-eval-pool-not-mini). The cheap $0 --opgrip smoke (no decode) is used ONLY to prove the wiring compiles and prints the ABSTAIN path — it is deliberately NOT the decisive measurement.
exec_steps: 1. Confirm self-op signatures in engine_cli.hexa: self_new(8,0), self_drift_exp(self,axis,rate), self_cos(a,b), self_anchor — already used at lanes 23/23b (L1007-1044); confirm a byte->axis helper exists (mod _afs_byte_feature) or add a 3-line _afs_byte_feature_axis wrapper.
2. Edit E0 flag + E1 pre-loop carriers + og_f3_self vector.
3. Edit E2 decode-live self update (JOLT quantity) in the g_text path; E3 urgency co-term guarded by og_live (leave self_ctx inert in the ÷42 pool).

4. Edit E4 in-loop og_live branch (brain_emit first, 3 arms, stage-split accumulators); E5 post-loop variance pre-gate + matched-noise/shuffle margin via stride-perms + disjointness ρ; E6 verdict print.
5. Build anima; $0 smoke on mini with plain --opgrip (no decode): confirm it compiles, baseline urgency arms unchanged, and self prints ABSTAIN (wiring-only, $0).

6. DECISIVE: dispatch `anima --opgrip-live` gen-capped 303M on summer pool (own-GEMM, OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 cap, single job), 200 ticks, ONE decode/tick; poll non-blocking; PULL results to permanent storage before teardown (a_fire_recover_complete).
7. Apply the frozen decision_rule to the printed numbers; cement the tier.

8. Write verdict file state/verdicts/9202_self_decode_jolt_urgency_grip (verbatim engine output), update the ARCHITECTURE.json gate node (research-verdicts-into-architecture), register H on 2 surfaces (HYPOTHESES.jsonl + card), land via harness pr-cycle.
spec.decision_rule: Read the --opgrip-live print, then in strict order: (0) If run was $0 --opgrip (P1 fail) -> ABSTAIN (do NOT read any self positive as competent). (1) If Hamming_N3 != 0 on either self arm OR Ψ_ON<Ψ_OFF (R1/R2) -> REJECT (became a gate / broke invariant), revert. (2) If variance pre-gate P2 fails (std_self < 0.5·std_cur) -> INCONCLUSIVE: encoder too weak, a null is uninterpretable (NOT proof of self-inertness — resolves the #3116 direction); iterate the byte->axis encoder, do not promote. (3) If P3 channel-dead -> INFRA-null, re-run. (4) With P1/P2/P3 passed and R clean: COMPETENT iff ΔEff_self(REM)>=0.08 AND ΔEff_self−ΔEff_noise>=0.08 AND ΔEff_self−ΔEff_shuffle>=0.05 AND |ρ(self,urg)|<0.3 — this is a genuine self-continuity emit-shade faculty, WIRE it live (a_verified_must_wire) with self_phasic in urgency + ARCHITECTURE lockstep. THEATER iff ΔEff_self<0.02 OR any margin collapses (noise/shuffle reproduces it) — self carries no shade beyond variance, do NOT wire, record the wall. DIRECTIONAL iff ΔEff_self in [0.02,0.08) or noise-margin in [0.05,0.08) — real-but-sub-bar signal, log + re-measure ≥2 seeds, no cement. The load-bearing distinction from all 4 REFUTALs: a POSITIVE only counts if it beats matched-noise AT THE SAME full-weight site (margin, not the channel-gameable absolute) on a REAL-decode content-coupled self — anything less is channel-power or noise-grip, not a faculty.
